pov: two-character external POV: only what Jason and Lucia say or observe
hook: We paid for two seats. There's the plane, there's our pilot, and he's drinking coffee.
alternative_hooks: The pilot could see what Jason couldn't.
Their getaway flight stayed tied to the dock.
alternative_hook_use: Replace scene 1 and re-time/recount the master before production; do not append.
script: We paid for two seats. There's the plane, there's our pilot, and he's drinking coffee. Look past him, Jason. The storm isn't over the island yet. It's sitting across the route we'd be taking. Our buyer leaves tonight. If we're absent, he keeps the deal. Tell me there's another flight. There isn't. There is a cancellation notice, and it says refunds at this counter. Keep them dry. I hate losing a score because somebody who doesn't know us decides the sky's wrong. We could ask him. You can. But ask him what he sees, instead of asking what he'd charge to ignore it. He says that black line hides the horizon. I didn't even know I was looking at a line. Neither did I. Take the refund. We'll buy breakfast where the floor stays still, and complain about the weather.
plot_mechanism: weather perspective defeats pressure to purchase unsafe passage
